transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I came in because I just... I don’t see things getting back on track anymore. My studio, my life—none of it. No matter how hard I work or what kind of payment plan they put in front of me, it feels hopeless.
Have you lost interest in things that you used to enjoy, like hobbies or activities?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t been paying much attention to hobbies lately, so I can’t say for certain.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, lately?

Yeah. Most days I wake up and it’s already there, this heavy gray feeling. It sticks around most of the day. Even when I’m in the shop around the wood, which used to feel good to me, everything just feels flat, and I have to push myself not to just stand there staring.
Have you been feeling more tired or lacking energy lately, even if you haven’t done anything physically or mentally exhausting?

Yeah, I have. Even if I sleep through the night, by midmorning my arms feel like I’ve been hauling lumber all day. I can still measure and cut, return calls, that kind of thing, but I’m wiped out doing it. It feels like I’m pushing through everything.
Have you been feeling like you’re not good enough or blaming yourself for things more than usual lately?

Yeah, I have. If a joint doesn’t line up perfectly, or I miss getting a bid in on time, I don’t just think, “I made a mistake.” I start thinking I’m a lousy carpenter, like maybe I had no business trying to run my own studio in the first place.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight lately, like eating less than usual or losing weight without trying?
I haven’t really noticed a big change there. My appetite’s maybe up and down a little, but I don’t think I’ve lost weight or anything like that.
Have you had episodes like this before, where you felt down and lost interest in things for an extended period of time?
I’m not really sure. I’ve had rough stretches before, sure, but I don’t know if I’d call them the same as this or say how long they lasted exactly.
Have you ever had a period in your life before this one where you felt down most days and lost interest in things for a couple of weeks or more?

I don’t really know. I mean, I’ve had times where I was down for a while, but I can’t say for sure it was most days for a couple weeks or that I lost interest like this. It’s kind of hard for me to pin down.
Can you recall if there was a time before this current period when you felt down most days and lost interest in things for at least a couple of weeks?

I honestly can’t recall a clear time like that before this. I’ve had down periods, but I don’t know if it was most days and with losing interest for a couple weeks or more. It’s hard for me to say for sure.
Can you remember if there was a time before this current period when you experienced a down mood and loss of interest in things for a continuous period of at least two weeks?
I can’t remember a clear time like that before this. I’ve had low stretches here and there, but I can’t say it was a full two weeks with both the down mood and losing interest.
Can you tell me if your current feelings of being down and losing interest in things have been happening almost every day for at least two weeks in a row?

Yes. It’s been pretty much every day, at least a couple weeks—really, most mornings I wake up and it’s already there, this heavy gray feeling. And even at work, around the wood and tools I used to enjoy, it just feels flat. I have to push myself not to just stand there staring.
Can you remember if you’ve ever had a time before this current period where you felt down most days and lost interest in things for two weeks or more, even if it was a while back?

I’m not really sure. I don’t remember a definite stretch before this where it was most days for two weeks or more and I also lost interest in things. I’ve had rough times, but I can’t pin it down like that.
Have you ever had a period in your life before this one where you felt down most days and lost interest in things for at least two weeks in a row?
I don’t really remember one like that before this. I’ve had bad patches, sure, but I can’t say there was a clear two weeks where I was down most days and not interested in things.
Have you ever had a period in your life before this one where you felt down most days and lost interest in things for at least two weeks in a row?
I don’t think so. Like I said, I’ve had bad stretches, but I can’t remember a clear time before this where it was most days for two weeks straight like that.
Have you ever had a period in your life before this one where you felt down most days and lost interest in things for at least two weeks in a row?
I don’t have a clear memory of that happening before this. I mean, I’ve had times where I felt low, but I can’t say it was both feeling down most days and losing interest for two weeks straight.

Have you ever had a time in your life before this current period where you experienced a major drop in mood and lost interest in things for two weeks or more, to the point where it significantly affected your daily life?
No, not that I can really point to. Before this, I had some rough times, but I don’t remember anything that clearly lasted two weeks or more and affected my day-to-day life like that.
